hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults using a custom bonding curve. In beforeSwap, it computes input/output amounts via CurveLib, takes input tokens from the PoolManager into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from a second Euler vault, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all pool accounting.
